outcome: Risk factors for MNM requiring ICU admission
Causes of MNM requiring ICU admission
cohort: 65 women with MNM admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) at a hospital in Jiangsu Province, China between January 1, 2015 and December 31, 2019
finding: Referral from another hospital and cesarean birth were identified as risk factors for MNM requiring ICU admission.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was a significant risk factor for MNM requiring ICU admission.
birth_weight: Neonates born to women with MNM admitted to the ICU had lower birth weight.
